cases.why: Refah really does send from «Refah Bank» — a name, not a number. The whole header is the identity: case and the spacing between the words are the carrier's noise, but a different name, or the words run together, is a different sender.

Issue #59. Refah heads the amount with its channel — «پایا», «کارت» — instead of «واریز», and glues the figure to it with the sign behind, so no word names a direction and the sign is the only thing that does. A sign was only read after whitespace or a colon, and every deposit arrived with no amount. The account's leading digits are invented; the reporter blacked them out.
